title: ARG Ephemeral Attestation Token
description: Single-use, short-lived authorization token minted by the ARG Identity Proxy for a specific execution tree node. Self-destructs after the sub-task payload is returned.

token_id.description: Unique identifier for this ephemeral token

node_id.description: Execution tree node this token is bound to

lineage_id.description: Identity lineage chain this token belongs to

purpose_classification_hash.description: Hash binding this token to its authorized purpose. Token is revoked if execution intent deviates.

allowed_endpoints.description: Exact endpoints this token is authorized to call. No others.

expires_at.description: Token self-destructs at this timestamp regardless of task completion
